queries.cypher: MATCH (report:CausalMultiomicsAgingPaper)-[:INVESTIGATES_AGING_CONSTRUCT]->(:AgingConstruct) WHERE report.corpus_id = 'eligible_graphs_101_v1_5_4' WITH DISTINCT report MATCH (report)-[:USES_OMICS_LAYER]->(omics:OmicsLayer) WITH report, count(DISTINCT omics.normalized_layer) AS layer_count WHERE layer_count >= 2 MATCH (report)-[:REPORTS_CAUSAL_ANALYSIS]->(analysis:CausalAnalysis) WHERE analysis.design_family IN ['genetic_instrument'] RETURN report.doi AS doi, report.title AS title, analysis.node_key AS source_id, analysis.design_family AS design_family, CASE WHEN analysis.provenance_json IS NULL OR analysis.provenance_json = '' THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END AS provenance_complete ORDER BY doi, source_id;
